To be clear though, I'm not taking credit for what happened. That was ALL on her. She should read her letters though it would have helped. Ah, too late.

#oneshot #vaporized
OMG! Hopefully she read this letter I sent to her on August 10th.
A war hungry governor unable to get war! Declaring it on his own government! People complacent. Wtf
Like it finally DAWNED on me and after living it. I mean he’s on the way out now (maybe Kenya). It was his opportunity to declare war. People IN OUR COMMUNITY died from this. Literally.
Treason is the crime of betraying your country or government, usually by trying to overthrow the state or helping its enemies.
If I hear of anyone in the ALI family getting put down for any of this I will mobilize every resource available to me. It will not happen.
Guys, Walz mobilized a citizen army against OUR OWN GOVERNMENT. That’s what we call Treason?
